header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.arabic_text: ذَكَرَ اللهُ (كَلَّا بَلْ سكتة رَانَ عَلي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَاكَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ۞)
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (المطففين:١٤) رواه الترمذي وقَالَ:هذا حديث حسن صحيح باب ومن سورة ويل للمطففين رقم:٣٣٣٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “When a servant commits a sin, a black spot appears on his heart. Then if he turns away from that sin and repents to Allah Ta'ala, (the black spot disappears and) the heart becomes clean. If after that sin he does not make Tawbah and Istighfar and sins even more, the blackness of the heart increases further. In the end the whole heart becomes black. It is about this rust that Allah Ta'ala has spoken in the verse (كَلَّا بَلْ سكتة رَانَ عَلي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَاكَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ) “Rust has settled on their hearts (because of the evil) they used to earn (Al-Mutaffifin:14).”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِنِ الصِّدِّيقِ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَا أَصَرَّ مَنِ اسْتَغْفَرَ وَإِنْ عَادَ فِي الْيَوْمِ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في الاستغفار رقم:١٥١٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “One who keeps seeking forgiveness for his sins is not counted as one who persists in sin, even if he sins seventy times in a day.”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- Any sin that is followed by regret and a firm intention not to sin again is forgivable, even if that sin happens again and again!.
(Badhl al-Majhud)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ لَزِمَ اْلاِسْتِغْفَارَ جَعَلَ اللهُ لَهُ مِنْ كُلِّ ضِيْقٍ مَخْرَجاً وَّمِنْ كُلِّ هَمٍّ فَرَجاً وَّرَزَقَهُ
